card.name: Partway through long drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a long drug or medical word, where the rest of the word is still to come (doc|etaxel, t|az|obactam, intr|amuscular). It is strongest in dosing and drug-listing text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug or chemical name that is split into several parts.
modes.example: the recommended dose of<< doc>>etaxel injection is 75

modes.label: Inside other long medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long lab, route, or pesticide term.

card.writes: It suppresses line breaks, so the word is expected to keep going rather than end the line.
card.plain: It marks that a long drug or medical word is only partly written and will continue.
